title.narrative: Partner Identification: DSU and the Socialist Youth of Argentina

description.narrative: This Partner Identification project will - if granted by DUF - take place in Buenos Aires and Rosario in Argentina. The primary goal of this partner identification is to investigate, if a future long term project partnership between DSU and the Socialist Youth of Argentina can be established. DSU and the Socialist Youth of Argentina cooperate through the International Union of Socialist Youth (IUSY), of which both organizations are members. Delegates from DSU and the Socialist Youth of Argentina met at a IUSY conference in Tirana in Albania earlier this year, and from that the idea of a joint project partnership was born. Both organizations are part of the global democratic socialist movement and thus share core values such as equality, diversity, democratic participation and the fight against climate change. During the partner identification study in Argentina, DSU and the Socialist Youth of Argentina will also meet with other Argentinian organizations that we can possibly work together with. During our preparations for this application, DSU and the Socialist Youth of Argentina agreed that a future project could focus on young people’s and women’s participation in Argentinian political life, which is why we will meet with movements working with these topics - primarily organizations with ties to the Argentinian labour movement. Please notice: DSU’s South America Group has submitted two partnership identification applications for this deadline for the International Pool - Columbia and Argentina. Flying to South America is very expensive. If both partnership identifications are granted, we will consider, if it is possible to visit both Colombia and Argentina in one trip in order to minimize the plane ticket costs.
